findings.title: Contract-to-contract calls must use the EVM alias, not the long-zero address
findings.detail: Calling SaucerSwap pair 0.0.2661051 at long-zero 0x...289abb from a contract returns success with ZERO bytes of return data, so Solidity reverts on abi.decode. The same call at its EVM alias 0xb0d84d87b45b99ed1c5f04bc84a9b5eb310dee16 returns 96 bytes correctly. Direct JSON-RPC calls succeed at BOTH addresses, so this only appears once logic runs inside a contract.
findings.impact: Silent failure mode. Any Hedera integration must resolve EVM aliases via the mirror node before hardcoding addresses.
findings.evidence: Prober contract 0x100c27ff9c338E06cDbbaaAcecf66021AD72628d, probe(address) on both forms.

findings.title: Hedera relay rejects forge's EIP-1559 fee fields
findings.detail: forge create without --legacy fails with 'Insufficient funds for transfer' even when the balance far exceeds gasLimit x gasPrice. Adding --legacy --gas-price <eth_gasPrice> deploys normally.

findings.title: Contract bytecode fits comfortably
findings.detail: 18,153 B deploy / 16,570 B runtime against the 24,576 limit; deployed for 4.63 HBAR at 114 tinybar/gas (4,062,576 gas).
findings.impact: Answers open question 5 in the prior research (bytecode size limit on Hedera).

findings.title: Contracts get unlimited HTS auto-association
findings.detail: The deployed vault shows max_automatic_token_associations = -1 (HIP-904), so the explicit associate() call is not needed and ~4.5 HBAR of association fees are avoided.

findings.title: HTS approve() reverts during contract construction
findings.detail: Calling approve() on an HTS token inside a constructor reverts. The contract is not yet associated with the token, and HIP-904 auto-association fires only on first RECEIPT, not at deployment. Confirmed: the deployed strategy shows max_automatic_token_associations=-1 but 0 associated tokens.
findings.impact: Move all HTS approvals out of constructors into a post-deploy call, and send a dust amount of each token to the contract first to trigger association.
findings.evidence: Deploy with constructor approvals reverted (eth_estimateGas also reverted); identical contract without them estimated 2,072,657 gas and deployed successfully.

findings.title: Yearn V3 TokenizedStrategy works on Hedera with HTS assets
findings.detail: The delegatecall singleton pattern functions correctly against an HTS token. Deployed verbatim (apiVersion 3.1.0) and the full ERC-4626 surface resolves through the strategy: name, symbol (ysHBARX), decimals 8 (read from the HTS facade inside delegatecall), asset, totalAssets, totalSupply, management, keeper, performanceFee 1000, profitMaxUnlockTime 864000.
findings.impact: The audited Yearn core is usable on Hedera. Reduces the custom, audit-requiring surface from ~600 lines to 155.

scope: Hedera platform-level integration findings. Third-party protocol status is excluded by design — it is point-in-time and belongs with those teams.
